name: Sunset
author: IGYO
description: IGYO Dark's quiet greys, lit by a gold-to-pink glow.
css: .i .i-arrow { display: none; } .i .i-chevron { display: inline; } :root[data-fx-loader="line"] .tc-progress > i { width: 42%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--sun-a) 30%, var(--sun-b) 70%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--sun-b), 0 0 16px color-mix(in oklab, var(--sun-a) 60%, transparent); } :root:not([data-o-tabs="attached"]) .tc-tab { border: 1px solid transparent; } :root:not([data-o-tabs="attached"]) .tc-tab.is-active { background: linear-gradient(var(--c-surface), var(--c-surface)) padding-box, var(--sun-line) border-box; box-shadow: var(--shadow-1), 0 0 12px color-mix(in oklab, var(--sun-b) 22%, transparent); } .t-switch input:checked + i { background: var(--sun-line); } .t-btn.is-primary, .t-btn.is-primary:hover { background: var(--sun-line); color: var(--sun-ink); } .t-btn.is-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .st-nav-item[aria-current="page"]::before { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--sun-a), var(--sun-b)); } #go { background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--sun-a), var(--sun-b)); color: #24262c; } #time { font-family: "Google Sans Flex", var(--f-display); } #backdrop:not(.photo) { background-color: #f0ac82; background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #976fa3 0%, #cb73a3 25%, #d57a9b 35%, #f1a67f 50%, #f0ac82 80%); } body.nt:not(.has-image) { --text: #fff; --text-2: rgba(255, 255, 255, .9); } body.nt:not(.has-image) #clock { text-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(60, 20, 50, .22); } body.nt:not(.has-image) .name { text-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(60, 20, 50, .45); } .tc-omni-star.is-on { color: #ffbc43; }
